title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Marine Phytoplankton Metabarcoding Using Zymo Research Kit
author: Andersson Agneta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bucjnsun

steps.title: Filter seawater onto 0.2 µm filter
steps.instruction: Filter a minimum of 500 mL seawater through a 0.2 µm Millipore filter (GSWP04700) using a vacuum pressure <200 mm Hg (267 mbar, 27 kPa); keep filtration time <60 min and start within 60 min of sampling. If start is delayed, incubate sample at near‑in‑situ temperature and record incubation time.

steps.title: Sanitize bench and set up equipment
steps.instruction: Wipe the work bench with 70 % ethanol. Prepare sterile forceps, a petri dish, pipettes of various sizes with filter tips, and beakers for waste. Turn on the microcentrifuge and set to 13 000 × g for 1 min. Set up a Vortex‑Genie 2 with adapter plates and a 10‑min timer.

steps.title: Thaw filter and add to lysis tube
steps.instruction: Thaw the filter in its sampling tube at room temperature, cut the membrane into small pieces and place them into a ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tube containing 0.1 mm and 0.5 mm beads.

steps.title: Roll filter into cryo tube
steps.instruction: Using two sterile forceps, grasp opposite edges of the filter membrane and roll it into a 2 mL Avantor cryo tube (catalog 479‑1262) with the top side of the filter facing inward.

steps.title: Record sample metadata
steps.instruction: Log station, date, sample ID, sampling time, filtration duration, filtered volume and any observations (e.g., filtration problems, colour of filter).

steps.title: Store filters
steps.instruction: Store filters at ≤ ‑20 °C for short‑term or ‑80 °C for long‑term storage. Optionally add DNA/RNA Shield™ (Zymo Research, R1103) for room‑temperature storage up to >1 year.

steps.title: Prepare spike‑in stock solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL sterile filtered autoclaved MQ water, DNase/RNase‑Free Water or TE buffer to the dry pellet of artificial 16S and 18S rRNA gene oligonucleotides to obtain a stock concentration of 10 ng/µL.

steps.title: Create working spike‑in dilutions
steps.instruction: Perform serial 10‑fold dilutions of the stock to reach final concentrations of 0.0002 ng/µL for the 16S spike‑in and 0.0007 ng/µL for the 18S spike‑in (as calculated to give ~5 % of total rRNA gene sequences). Record the dilution factor.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze spike‑ins
steps.instruction: Aliquot the working spike‑in solutions into tubes and store at ‑20 °C until needed.

steps.title: Add lysis solution to tube
steps.instruction: Rinse the sampling tube with 750 µL, then add ZymoBIOMICS Lysis Solution to the ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tube. (If the sample was stored in DNA/RNA Shield™ Lysis buffer, skip this addition and proceed to spike‑in addition.)

steps.title: Add spike‑in to lysate
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of the prepared 16S spike‑in dilution and 10 µL of the 18S spike‑in dilution to the lysate tube and cap tightly.

steps.title: Bead‑beat sample
steps.instruction: Secure the tube in a Vortex‑Genie 2 with a 2 mL tube holder adapter and vortex at maximum speed (≈3200 rpm, 2850 Hz) for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin the ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tubes at 13 000 × g for 1 minute at room temperature; collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 400 µL of supernatant to a Zymo‑Spin™ III‑F Filter (red mark) placed in a collection tube, centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 1 minute, then discard the filter.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 200 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Binding Buffer to the filtrate in the collection tube and mix well.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column – first load
steps.instruction: Transfer 800 µL of the mixture to a Zymo‑Spin™ IICR Column in a collection tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column – second load
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer of the remaining 800 µL mixture to the same IICR column, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column – buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 1 to the IICR column, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column – buffer 2 (first)
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column – buffer 2 (second)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute (no further discard needed).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the IICR column into a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 50 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNase/RNase‑Free Water (or sterile TE) directly onto the column matrix, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Inhibitor removal – HRC prep
steps.instruction: Place a new Zymo‑Spin™ III‑HRC Filter in a fresh collection tube, add 600 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ HRC Prep Solution, and centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Label HRC filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the HRC filter to a clean 1.5 mL tube and label both lid and side with a unique, freeze‑resistant marker.

steps.title: Pass eluate through HRC filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the DNA eluate from step 21 to the HRC filter and centrifuge at exactly 16 000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Store and quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Freeze the extracted genomic DNA at ‑20 °C or ‑80 °C. Measure DNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
